_comment: 00186 — the execution-fence ratchet for state-changing shipped recipes in src/commands/start.md. Two separate structures, mirroring .ctoc/reachability-baseline.json. 'covered' recipes have a fixture + assertion in tests/shipped-recipes-execute.test.js and are proven by RUNNING them; it may only GROW. 'uncovered' state-changing recipes exist and have no fixture yet, each with a one-line reason; it may only SHRINK. A new state-changing recipe in start.md absent from BOTH lists fails the test. 'id' is recipe-harness.recipeId (sha1 of the normalized program), matched against a live scan.

covered.label: create-plan (allocatePlanNumber)
covered.effect: stakes an exclusive claim file under .ctoc/state/plan-numbers/ and returns the 5-digit number

covered.label: cleanup-exec per-plan (executeCleanup)
covered.effect: archives a seeded-stale review plan to plans/done/; returns to:done, never skipped:true (the 00185 defect, generalized)

uncovered.label: plan-number repair (renumberImplementationPlans)
uncovered.reason: needs a multi-plan fixture with unnumbered implementation plans and cross-references (parent_plan/depends_on) to rewrite; heavier fixture deferred

uncovered.label: cleanup-exec category batch (_buildCleanupItems + executeCleanup)
uncovered.reason: needs a git-initialised fixture with a category of dead-on-arrival plans; the per-plan executeCleanup form is covered

uncovered.label: dismiss-stale (scanCheapCandidates + dismissStale)
uncovered.reason: needs a fixture seeded with stale candidates so the dismissal is non-empty and observable

uncovered.label: set-compliance-regime (writeActiveProfiles)
uncovered.reason: the shipped program passes a bare ARR identifier substituted from the {profile} enum and needs a .ctoc/settings.yaml fixture with an active_profiles line; not executable as-extracted without modelling the profile->array substitution

uncovered.label: ledger-backfill --vision (approve-stubs / maintainer script)
uncovered.reason: script recipe needing a plans/done/ decomposed-vision fixture and approval-ledger seeding to observe an idempotent backfill entry
